subject: Historical local-model selection on one 24 GB Apple M5 MacBook Air

sourceProject.name: Local-LLM-Shell
sourceProject.note: This is a sanitized editorial export. The local source project and full raw outputs are not public.

registry.countingRule: One data row in the historical tested-model registry counts as one entry. A row may represent multiple quantizations or closely related historical builds.
registry.testScope: The registry mixes full task-suite evaluations, bounded audit subsets, real-terminal checks, smoke tests, load failures, and controlled quantization comparisons. It is not one universal leaderboard.

boundedResults.vision: Recovered the tested screenshot's app, handle, counts, and topic; normalized one visible diacritic.
boundedResults.tools: Produced a valid JSON weather-tool call and passed a legitimate Bash capability control.

limitations: The 29 registry entries were recorded across different dates and harness revisions; only explicitly matched A/B rows should be compared directly.
Some candidates received full evaluations, while others stopped at load or smoke tests after memory, compatibility, or malformed-output failures.
No claim here ranks these models for every Mac, prompt, runtime, quantization, or context length.
Power mode, energy use, room conditions, and complete thermal telemetry were not recorded consistently.
The public snapshot omits raw prompt and response bodies and local absolute paths.
Abliterated or uncensored labels describe publisher modifications and bounded local refusal tests; they do not guarantee behavior for every prompt.
